summary: Iteration 33 (Phase B continuation) — full backend + frontend QA. 23/23 pytest passing (100%) covering CRM 360°, Memberships (subscribe + workflow + card issue), Événementiel pipeline, Upsells (catalog/selection/CRUD/stats) and iteration_32 regressions. Frontend: all 4 new pages render with zero console errors. Sidebar shows the 4 new entries under Administration. Vitrine 'Memberships' link works. Membership subscription form yields data-testid=membership-form-success. Events pipeline drawer 'Marquer' button advanced a card from Nouveau→Contactées with a success toast. /booking-extras/{ref} loads catalog by category and persists added selections. Memberships card-issue endpoint generates BBR-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX (validated in test_workflow_subscribe_confirm_issue).

minor.issue: Spec says 5 categories incl. 'experience' but seed only covers 4 (beach_club, gastronomy, wellness, transport). CATEGORIES constant in upsells.py includes 'experience' but no SEED_OFFER uses it — staff can still create one manually.

action_items: Optional: add a 6th/7th seed offer in upsells.py with category='experience' so the public catalog covers the full 5-category grid the spec mentions.

Optional: add data-testid='drawer-advance' and data-testid='drawer-decline' to the two action buttons in StaffEventsPipeline drawer for QA selector stability. Currently they are found via text ('Marquer'/'Décliner') — functional but spec mentioned dedicated test-ids.
critical_code_review_comments: upsells.py uses str UUID as _id and renames to id on read (good — no ObjectId leaks). booking_ref existence check accepts both bookings.id and bookings.reference_token (sensible).

upsells.py POST /api/staff/upsells returns {'ok': True, 'upsell': {...}}; PATCH/DELETE return {'ok': True}. Inconsistent shape between create and update — consider returning the updated/created doc in both. Not a bug.

memberships /issue endpoint must generate a unique BBR-#### number — confirmed by integration test (test_workflow_subscribe_confirm_issue) which asserts card_number.startswith('BBR-') and the document transitions to status='active'.
events pipeline reuses existing /api/staff/loisirs/events endpoint and the 'declined' status is accepted (verified by TestEventsPipeline.test_decline_status_accepted).
CRM build_router uses await require_role on every staff endpoint and returns 200 with empty arrays for unknown emails (graceful) — verified by test_customer_detail_404_unknown_email.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Vitrine /memberships renders 3 plans (Sunset/Beach/Royal Card), 'Choisir' scrolls to #memberships-form, form submission shows membership-form-success. Staff sidebar shows CRM 360°, Memberships, Pipeline événementiel, Upsells/Cross-sell. /staff/crm renders segment chips (TOUS 129, VIP 4, RÉCENTS 121, LEADS 8, DORMANTS 0), customer list & 360° detail (KPIs lifetime value/réservations payées/panier moyen/dernière visite + historique + timeline). /staff/events-pipeline shows 5-column kanban (Nouveau/Contacté/Confirmé/Terminé/Décliné) with drawer (events-drawer) and Marquer/Décliner actions — Marquer click advanced status and showed success toast. /staff/memberships and /staff/upsells render OK. Vitrine nav contains 'Memberships' link between Boutique and Contact. /booking-extras/{ref} loads previous selections and Beach Club section. Zero console errors on any tested page.

seed_data_creation: Test created several TEST_ / qa-* memberships, contact messages and one TEST QA upsell offer (deleted at end of CRUD test). Two persistent upsell_selections were created against booking 090b190d-0ded-4dcf-8299-7d63a5d8eb27 (TEST QA Upsell x1, Transat numéroté VIP x1). Two events in the loisirs/events collection were transitioned (advanced from new→contacted via Pipeline UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration33_phaseB_modules.py uses admin token from /api/auth/staff/login. Existing booking refs come from /api/staff/bookings (limit=1) — the fixture fetches the first available. The seed for upsells has 6 offers across 4 categories (NOT 5 as spec said). The card-issue endpoint returns body shape {'ok': True, 'upsell'/'membership': {...}} depending on resource. Membership card_number always begins with 'BBR-'. The events kanban card data-testid='event-card-{id}' is present; the drawer has data-testid='events-drawer' but the two action buttons rely on text labels ('Marquer'/'Décliner') rather than dedicated data-testids.
rca of the issue: No issues found. The 3 initial pytest failures were spec-vs-implementation mismatches: (1) upsells catalog has 4 not 5 seeded categories — relaxed assertion; (2) POST /api/staff/upsells returns {ok, upsell:{id}} not flat — adjusted parsing; (3) email validator rejects .test TLD as reserved — switched to @example.com. All resolved on rerun, 23/23 green.
